mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the arm to the circulation was most worthwhile because the tissue inset showed oxygen and nutrients reaching muscle cells, carbon dioxide returning to blood, and fluid remaining in tissue spaces.

leastWorthwhile.text: Inspecting the return ducts was least useful: it showed no available partners but did not explain what had to be assembled first.

surprise.text: I expected the lymph pathways to connect directly to the return ducts, but the arm assembly had to come first.

arbitrary.text: The required assembly order felt somewhat arbitrary because the duct description already said it joined large veins, but the game gave no explanation when the direct combination failed.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter to see how the connected systems support the body, though I would hope for clearer feedback when an apparently plausible connection is unavailable.
